job.organization: Santa Clarita Community College District (CA) / College of the Canyons (CA)

items.item_text: 01. Do you possess an education equivalent to an Associate’s degree (60 semester units) or higher from an accredited institution? If yes, list your degree(s) and please provide a legible copy of your college/university transcript(s) in your online application packet. Copies of diplomas are not acceptable in lieu of college transcripts. If no, and you are using additional years of work experience in lieu of the semester units of education, please clearly indicate how you meet the minimum educational requirement through this additional work experience.

02. Please describe your general clerical and office support experience in a position such as an administrative assistant, executive assist, office manager, office coordinator, etc. Please highlight your experience working with MS Office Suite, specifically MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Include employer names(s), position title(s), dates of employment, full-time or part-time status (hours per week), your roles and responsibilities. Please provide your total years of full-time experience in this field.
03. Please describe your experiences working with children, parents, and adult students and the roles you played in serving them.
04. Please describe your methods for organizing multiple projects and daily work.
05. Please describe any experience you may have working with others in a collaborative, team environment.
06. Please describe your experience in maintaining a variety of records, files, and databases. Please give examples of your spreadsheet and database management experience.
07. Please describe your ability to work successfully and thrive in a multicultural, diverse environment.
08. Why do you want to work at College of the Canyons in this full-time staff position?
